electronbump.text: Electron <version> is at least 3 days old (pin <pin>): bump the exact pin, the lockfile and config/electron_pin.json under the written upgrade policy (decision 0070). ACCEPT: all three name <version>; npm test, the static guards, npm audit signatures and the docs freshness test pass. ZERO-CLICK: the loop works it. SOURCE: watch electron <version>, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.

electronmajor.text: Electron <MAJ> is due (line <PINMAJ> ends <eol>): move to the next major under the written upgrade policy (decision 0070) and re-measure the decision 0002 budgets. ACCEPT: a pin on line <MAJ> or a dated plan. SOURCE: watch electron major <MAJ>, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.

npmaudit.text: npm audit reports a <severity> advisory on <package> in the app lockfile: move it to the newest release at least 3 days old that clears it, within 24 h (decision 0070 item 2; for electron also config/electron_pin.json). ACCEPT: npm audit --package-lock-only --prefix app names no advisory on <package>; npm test, the static guards and npm audit signatures pass. ZERO-CLICK: the loop works it. SOURCE: watch npm-audit <package>, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.
